config.hubs.name: Hubs
config.hubs.description: Voice channels that create a temporary voice channel for whoever joins them. In the name, {user} is replaced by the member's display name. A limit of 0 means no limit.
config.hubs.fields.name: Channel name
hub.saved: {{channel}} now creates a temporary voice channel for whoever joins it.
hub.removed: {{channel}} no longer creates temporary voice channels. The channels already created are kept until they are empty.
hub.unknownChannel: This voice channel no longer exists.
hub.isTemporary: A temporary voice channel cannot be a hub.
hub.invalidName: The channel name must be 1 to 100 characters long.
hub.invalidLimit: The user limit must be a whole number from 0 to 99.
hub.missingPermissions: The bot cannot create channels next to {{channel}}: it lacks {{permissions}}.
hub.cooldown: you just created a channel: try again {{time}}.
hub.unavailable: the bot lacks the permissions to create your channel. Ask an administrator.
panel.ownerAway: {{owner}} has left the channel. Anyone still in it can claim it.
panel.footer: -# Only the owner and moderators can use this panel. Your settings (name, limit, access, invited, blocked) carry over to your next channel.
panel.outdated: This panel was out of date: a new one has just been posted in the channel.
panel.notReplaced: This panel is out of date, but the bot could not post a new one. Ask an administrator.
panel.expired: This menu has expired: open it again from the channel panel.
mode.open.label: Open
mode.open.description: Everyone can see the channel and join it
mode.open.done: The channel is open: everyone can see and join it.
mode.invite.label: Invite only
mode.invite.description: Visible to everyone, only your invited members can join
mode.invite.done: The channel is invite only: everyone sees it, only your invited members can join.
mode.private.label: Private
mode.private.description: Hidden from everyone but your invited members
mode.private.done: The channel is private: only your invited members can see and join it.
modal.edit.title: Name and limit
modal.edit.name: Channel name
members.title: **Channel members**
members.trust: Invite: can join even when invite only or private
members.block: Block: can no longer see the channel, disconnected if inside
members.kick: Disconnect: removes from the channel, they can come back
members.untrust: Remove from a list: cancels an invite or a block
members.transfer: Choose a member in the channel
select.noMember: This member is no longer on the server.
action.notTemporary: This is not a temporary voice channel.
action.notOwner: Only the owner of the channel can do this.
access.full: The invited and blocked lists cannot hold more than {{max}} members in total.
rename.pending: Discord is holding the rename back: the channel will be called **{{name}}** in a few minutes.
rename.invalid: The name must be 1 to 100 characters long.
rename.rateLimited: Discord only allows renaming a channel twice every 10 minutes: try again {{time}}.
limit.done: At most {{limit}} members can join the channel.
limit.removed: The channel no longer has a user limit.
limit.invalid: The limit must be a whole number from 0 to 99.
trust.done: {{users}} can now join, even when the channel is invite only or private.
trust.none: Choose members other than the owner and the bots.
notify.dm: {{user}} invites you to their voice channel on **{{guild}}**: {{channel}}
notify.done: DM sent to {{users}}, with the link to the channel.
notify.partial: DM sent to {{users}}. {{failed}} could not be reached by DM.
notify.failed: {{failed}} could not be reached by DM.
notify.already: They were already notified less than 10 minutes ago.
notify.none: These members are no longer invited.
notify.expired: This button has expired: invite the members again to notify them.
revoke.done: {{users}} removed from your lists: their access follows the channel mode again.
revoke.none: These members were neither invited nor blocked.
block.done: {{users}} can no longer see or join the channel.
block.none: Choose members other than yourself, the owner and the bots.
kick.done: {{users}} disconnected. To keep them from coming back, use Block.
kick.none: None of these members is in the channel.
kick.failed: The bot could not disconnect these members.
claim.notInChannel: Join the channel to claim it.
claim.ownerPresent: {{owner}} is still in the channel: ask them to transfer it to you.
claim.ownsAnother: You already own another temporary channel.
transfer.empty: Nobody else is in the channel to receive it.
transfer.invalid: Choose another member than the owner, and not a bot.
transfer.notInChannel: {{user}} must be in the channel to receive it.
delete.confirm: Delete **{{name}}**? The {{count}} member(s) in it will be disconnected. The channel disappears anyway once it is empty.
delete.failed: The bot could not delete the channel.
